relations.rationale: Xavi needing more practice provides a plausible motive for suggesting another run-through, making it more likely.
The need for more practice supports the idea that the group would do another final pass rehearsal.
Needing more practice doesn't determine whether the song ends cleanly or not; these are largely independent outcomes.
Needing more practice doesn't preclude the group applauding their progress afterward.
Hana's suggestion directly leads to Otto's agreement and the group returning to positions for the final pass.
Suggesting a run-through makes it plausible that the song eventually ends, including cleanly.
The suggestion to run through once more before wrapping up supports that they would later pack up for the night.
The group starting the final pass sets up the scenario where the song could end, supporting that it ended cleanly.
Starting the final pass of the evening supports the later act of applauding and packing up for the night.
The song ending cleanly supports the idea that everyone would applaud their progress afterward.
